question: In a certain code language, 'HUMP' is written as 'GTLO' and 'LIKE' is written as 'KHJD'. How will 'PLAY' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'HUMP' is written as 'GTLO',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a69bc4a7c1359b72baa4154078871387dbed2c7d1e63be7c775d96f229edf744.png] 

For, 'LIKE' is written as 'KHJD',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ba9b013132445c0b20e93d662d2666294e707c2a49341700d51d1908a5db0df.png] 

Similarly, for '**PLAY**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53cf1ba62f050c5a8638737a858264bd85598eb7e393cb0c7f1c64be9a575d6e.png] 

So, 'PLAY' will be written as '**OKZX**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
